template_data.lead_html: From "honestly, I've been waiting" to first federal award.

rows.what_html: Schedule approved — no pipeline activity — waiting for RFQs to arrive on their own
Sources sought, agency outreach, recompete tracking — started moving instead of waiting
First award lands — built by action, not by luck

template_data.closer: THE DOOR IS OPEN. YOU STILL HAVE TO KNOCK.
